refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.sysext is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.sysext
type ImageClass( sysext, confext )
type ImageType( directory, subvolume, raw, block, mstack )
method Merge( class: ?ImageClass, force: ?bool, noReload: ?bool, noexec: ?bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
method Unmerge( class: ?ImageClass, noReload: ?bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
method Refresh( class: ?ImageClass, force: ?bool, noReload: ?bool, alwaysRefresh: ?bool, noexec: ?bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# [Requires 'more' flag] method List( class: ?ImageClass, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( Class: ImageClass, Type: ImageType, Name: string, Path: ?string, ReadOnly: bool, CreationTimestamp: ?int, ModificationTimestamp: ?int, Usage: ?int, UsageExclusive: ?int, Limit: ?int, LimitExclusive: ?int )
error NoImagesFound()
error AlreadyMerged( hierarchy: string )

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.sysext shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.sysext.Merge '{}' invokes its Merge method.
